form_analysis.feedback: Focused aftercare form for a treatment aimed at moisture restoration. Provides clear guidance on locking in hydration and avoiding dehydrating agents. Strong emphasis on product layering and environmental protection. Appropriately low-risk with no major emergency protocols.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is essential to maximise and prolong the deep hydration benefits of your treatment, helping to maintain your skin's plump, dewy, and smooth appearance.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow this aftercare advice to protect and enhance your skin's hydration levels.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: Your skin will feel immediately softer, smoother, and more supple. It may have a slight sheen from the hydrating products. Any mild redness or warmth should subside within 1-2 hours.

sections.title: Maximising Hydration
items: Do not wash your face for at least 6-8 hours after treatment to allow the hyaluronic acid and humectants to fully penetrate.
For the next 72 hours, focus on 'locking in' moisture. Apply your hydrating serum followed by a richer moisturizer or face oil as a final step, especially at night.
Consider using a hydrating mist throughout the day to refresh your skin.

sections.title: Product Restrictions
sections.content: Avoid using any drying or exfoliating products (such as salicylic acid, strong retinoids, physical scrubs) for at least 5-7 days. These can compromise your newly restored skin barrier and undo the hydrating effects.

sections.title: Environmental Protection
items: Sun exposure, wind, and dry air (like air conditioning or central heating) can dehydrate skin. Apply a broad-spectrum SPF 30+ daily and consider using a humidifier, especially at night.
Avoid saunas, steam rooms, and very long hot showers for 48 hours, as excessive heat can lead to transepidermal water loss.

sections.title: Internal Hydration
sections.content: Drink plenty of water over the next few days to support your skin's hydration from within. Limit caffeine and alcohol intake as they have a diuretic effect.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: You may apply makeup after 2-3 hours if needed. Ensure it is applied gently and consider using hydrating or dewy-finish formulas to complement your skin's condition.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: It is very rare to have an adverse reaction to a hydrating facial. However, if you experience persistent itching, a rash, or increased dryness, please contact your therapist.
The peak of hydration and plumpness is typically seen 24-48 hours post-treatment and can last for 5-7 days with proper home care.
Regular treatments are recommended to maintain optimal hydration levels, especially in changing seasons.
